<?php
// Test fixture only (never shipped): /wp-admin/?chs_test_reset=1 puts the plugin back
// in its just-activated state, so the first-visit auto-scan can run again on a
// reused Playground server or a Playwright retry.
add_action( 'admin_init', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['chs_test_reset'] ) || ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	delete_option( 'chs_settings' );
	delete_option( 'chs_autoscanned' );
	delete_transient( 'chs_scan_' . get_current_user_id() );
	delete_option( 'chs_welcome' );
	delete_option( 'chs_events_status' );
	delete_transient( 'chs_events_cache' );
	delete_option( 'chs_featured_status' );
	delete_transient( 'chs_featured_cache' );
	delete_option( 'chs_test_featured_extra' );
	update_option( 'chs_flush_rewrite', 1, false );
	wp_die( 'chs reset', '', array( 'response' => 200 ) );
} );

<?php
// Test fixture only (never shipped): a fake Planning Center Calendar API.
// Key "test-app-id" / "test-secret" works; anything else gets a 401. Without the
// Church Center filter the events list also returns an internal staff meeting,
// so a missing filter shows up as "Elder Meeting" on the page.
add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) {
	if ( 0 !== strpos( $url, 'https://api.planningcenteronline.com/calendar/v2/' ) ) {
		return $pre;
	}
	$reply = function ( $code, $body ) {
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => wp_json_encode( $body ), 'response' => array( 'code' => $code, 'message' => '' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	};
	if ( 'Basic ' . base64_encode( 'test-app-id:test-secret' ) !== ( $args['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '' ) ) {
		return $reply( 401, array( 'errors' => array( array( 'title' => 'Unauthorized', 'detail' => 'Invalid Application ID or Secret.' ) ) ) );
	}
	$path = rawurldecode( substr( $url, strlen( 'https://api.planningcenteronline.com/calendar/v2' ) ) );
	// Featured: one real, one awaiting approval, one not featured at all (the plugin
	// must check the flag itself too). /wp-admin/?chs_test_feature=1 features another
	// the way staff would in Planning Center; =0 unfeatures it.
	if ( 0 === strpos( $path, '/events?' ) && false !== strpos( $path, 'where[featured]=true' ) ) {
		$data = array(
			array( 'id' => '201', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Fall Retreat', 'featured' => true, 'approval_status' => 'A', 'visible_in_church_center' => true, 'summary' => 'Two days at Camp Hebron. Sign up by Sunday.', 'image_url' => '', 'registration_url' => 'https://harborchurch.churchcenter.com/registrations/events/201' ) ),
			array( 'id' => '202', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Trunk or Treat', 'featured' => true, 'approval_status' => 'P', 'visible_in_church_center' => true ) ),
			array( 'id' => '203', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Staff Retreat', 'featured' => false, 'approval_status' => 'A', 'visible_in_church_center' => true ) ),
		);
		if ( get_option( 'chs_test_featured_extra' ) ) {
			$data[] = array( 'id' => '204', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Christmas Eve Services', 'featured' => true, 'approval_status' => 'A', 'visible_in_church_center' => true, 'summary' => '', 'image_url' => '', 'registration_url' => null ) );
		}
		return $reply( 200, array( 'data' => $data, 'links' => array() ) );
	}
	if ( 0 === strpos( $path, '/events?' ) ) {
		$data = array(
			array( 'id' => '101', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Grief Care', 'approval_status' => 'A', 'visible_in_church_center' => true ) ),
			array( 'id' => '102', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Pending Picnic', 'approval_status' => 'P', 'visible_in_church_center' => true ) ),
		);
		if ( false === strpos( $path, 'where[visible_in_church_center]=true' ) ) {
			$data[] = array( 'id' => '103', 'type' => 'Event', 'attributes' => array( 'name' => 'Elder Meeting', 'approval_status' => 'A', 'visible_in_church_center' => false ) );
		}
		return $reply( 200, array( 'data' => $data, 'links' => array(), 'meta' => array( 'total_count' => count( $data ) ) ) );
	}
	if ( preg_match( '#^/events/(\d+)/event_instances#', $path, $m ) ) {
		$names = array( '101' => 'Grief Care', '102' => 'Pending Picnic', '103' => 'Elder Meeting', '201' => 'Fall Retreat', '202' => 'Trunk or Treat', '203' => 'Staff Retreat', '204' => 'Christmas Eve Services' );
		$data  = array();
		foreach ( '204' === $m[1] ? array( 5, 12 ) : array( 2, 9 ) as $days ) {
			$data[] = array( 'id' => $m[1] . $days, 'type' => 'EventInstance', 'attributes' => array(
				'name' => $names[ $m[1] ], 'starts_at' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d\T23:30:00\Z', time() + $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS ), 'all_day_event' => false,
				'location' => 'Fellowship Hall - 123 Main St, Harbor, PA 17000', 'church_center_url' => 'https://harborchurch.churchcenter.com/calendar/event/' . $m[1] . $days,
			) );
		}
		return $reply( 200, array( 'data' => $data, 'links' => array() ) );
	}
	return $reply( 404, array( 'errors' => array( array( 'title' => 'Not Found' ) ) ) );
}, 10, 3 );
add_action( 'admin_init', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['chs_test_feature'] ) && current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		update_option( 'chs_test_featured_extra', (int) $_GET['chs_test_feature'] );
		// Stand in for the 15-minute cache running out.
		delete_transient( 'chs_featured_cache' );
		wp_die( 'chs feature ' . (int) $_GET['chs_test_feature'] );
	}
} );
